scripts.title: Chess Assistant
scripts.summary: The simplest way to improve your game. Displays the strongest move instantly on your board.
scripts.code:
local Services = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(Self, Service)
            return cloneref(game:GetService(Service))
        end
    })

    local Players = Services.Players
    local UserInputService = Services.UserInputService
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local App = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ChessClient.App)
    local mastermindbotplayer = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Chess.VortexBot)
    local BoardHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Chess.Engine)

    -- variables
    local Lasttimeplayed = -1
    local dragging       = false
    local dragStart      = nil
    local panelStartPos  = nil

    -- gui
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "MoveAssist"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 70)
    panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 68)
    panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 17)
    panel.BorderSizePixel = 1
    panel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 60)
    panel.Active = true
    panel.Parent = gui

    local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32)
    titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    titleBar.Parent = panel

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -25, 1, 0)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    title.TextSize = 13
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Text = "move assist"
    title.Parent = titleBar

    local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
    close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 22)
    close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
    close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    close.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    close.TextSize = 14
    close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    close.Text = "X"
    close.Parent = titleBar

    local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -28)
    status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 28)
    status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    status.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    status.TextSize = 15
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    status.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    status.Text = "Join a Game"
    status.Parent = panel

    titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging       = true
            dragStart      = input.Position
            panelStartPos  = panel.Position
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            panel.Position = UDim2.new(panelStartPos.X.Scale, panelStartPos.X.Offset + d.X, panelStartPos.Y.Scale, panelStartPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)

    close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        pcall(function() App.board:setArrow("best", nil) end)
        gui:Destroy()
    end)


    -- logic / the main stuff

    local function clearArrow()
        pcall(function() App.board:setArrow("best", nil) end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.25) do
            if not gui.Parent then 
                break 
            end
            
            local sexsision = App.session

            if not sexsision or sexsision.kind ~= "online" or sexsision.over then
                status.Text = "Join a Game"
                clearArrow()
                Lasttimeplayed = -1

            elseif not sexsision:isMyTurn() then
                if #sexsision.ucis ~= Lasttimeplayed then
                    clearArrow()
                    Lasttimeplayed = -1
                end
                status.Text = "Wait for your turn"

            elseif #sexsision.ucis ~= Lasttimeplayed then
                local theSigmaMove = mastermindbotplayer.think(sexsision.startFen, table.clone(sexsision.ucis), { rating = 1200 }, {})
                local whereItWas, whereItGoes = theSigmaMove:sub(1, 2), theSigmaMove:sub(3, 4)

                App.board:setArrow("best", BoardHelper.algToIndex64(whereItWas), BoardHelper.algToIndex64(whereItGoes), Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 130), 0.2)
                
                Lasttimeplayed = #sexsision.ucis
                status.Text = whereItWas .. " > " .. whereItGoes
            end
        end
    end)

scripts.title: [open source] silent aim all guns / vehicles
scripts.author: BadChuKun
scripts.summary: voxel wars fps silent aim
scripts.code:
local Players, RS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local lp, cam = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = { fov = 160, hitChance = 85, headChance = 55, wallcheck = true, players = true, bots = true }

local FIRE = {}
for _, n in ipairs({ "FireRifle", "FireSMG", "FireLMG", "FirePistol", "FireDMR", "FireSniper", "FireShotgun" }) do
	local r = RS.Voxel.Remotes:FindFirstChild(n)
	if r then FIRE[r] = n end
end
local Ballistics = require(RS.Voxel.Ballistics)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function alive(model)
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
end

local function pick()
	local center, best, bestDist = cam.ViewportSize / 2, nil, CFG.fov
	local myTeam = tostring(lp.Team)
	local function consider(model)
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root or not alive(model) then return end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
		if not on then return end
		local d = (Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center).Magnitude
		if d >= bestDist then return end
		if CFG.wallcheck then
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, model }
			if workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, root.Position - cam.CFrame.Position, params) then return end
		end
		best, bestDist = model, d
	end
	if CFG.players then
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl ~= lp and pl.Character and (pl.Team == nil or pl.Team ~= lp.Team) then consider(pl.Character) end
		end
	end
	local rigs = CFG.bots and workspace:FindFirstChild("BotRigs")
	if rigs then
		for _, m in ipairs(rigs:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("Team") ~= myTeam then consider(m) end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function rewrite(name, a)
	local muzzle = a[1]
	if typeof(muzzle) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(a[2]) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	if math.random(100) > CFG.hitChance then return end
	local model = pick()
	if not model then return end
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(math.random(100) <= CFG.headChance and "Head" or "UpperTorso")
	if not part then return end

	local speed, arc = Ballistics.SPEED or 1700, nil
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		speed = Ballistics.RIFLE_SPEED * ((tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("GsVelocity"))) or 1)
		arc = Ballistics.RIFLE_ARC
	end

	local point = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12)) / 100
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		local dist = (point - muzzle).Magnitude
		local ok, t = pcall(Ballistics.flightTime, dist, speed, arc)
		point += root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * (ok and t or dist / speed)
	end

	local plain = (point - muzzle).Unit
	local aim = plain
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local ok, v = pcall(Ballistics.launch, muzzle, point, speed, arc)
		if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude > 0.5 then aim = v.Unit end
	end

	if name == "FireShotgun" then
		for i = 3, #a do if typeof(a[i]) == "Vector3" then a[i] = plain end end
	else
		a[2] = aim
		if typeof(a[4]) == "Vector3" then a[4] = plain end
		if typeof(a[5]) == "number" then a[5] = 0 end
	end
end

local old
old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
	local method = getnamecallmethod()
	local name = method == "FireServer" and FIRE[self]
	if name then
		local a, n = { ... }, select("#", ...)
		pcall(rewrite, name, a)
		setnamecallmethod(method)
		return old(self, table.unpack(a, 1, n))
	end
	return old(self, ...)
end))

scripts.author: emericklabrick11
scripts.summary: Auto fight for Beyond Nen, only for the first boss to beat him.
scripts.code:
--[[
    Beyond Nen - Auto Parry / Dodge / Auto Fight  (single file, GUI included)

    - Automatic parry on the attacks that actually deal damage
    - Dodge (Q) on heavy attacks, automatic exit from red telegraph zones
    - Auto Fight: walks up to the boss and only attacks during its endlag

    Target executors: Wave / Delta / Solara
    Keys:     [P] everything on/off | [G] Auto Fight | [Right Ctrl] hide the panel | [End] unload
    Settings: see the CONFIG table below
]]

-- Prevent double execution: unload the previous instance first
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.BeyondNenAutoParry then
    pcall(env.BeyondNenAutoParry)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG (adjust per game / boss)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local CONFIG = {
    ParryKey      = Enum.KeyCode.F,   -- parry key in the game
    ToggleKey     = Enum.KeyCode.P,   -- enable / disable everything
    UnloadKey     = Enum.KeyCode.End, -- unload the script
    Range         = 14,               -- max distance (studs) of an attacker
    FacingDot     = 0.2,              -- 1 = facing you exactly, -1 = back turned; >0.2 = roughly facing you
    ReactionDelay = 0.12,             -- delay before parrying after the animation starts (s)
    HoldTime      = 0.08,             -- key press duration (s)
    Cooldown      = 0.35,             -- minimum delay between two parries (s)
    TargetPlayers = true,             -- react to players
    TargetNPCs    = true,             -- react to NPCs / mobs

    -- Animation priorities treated as attacks
    -- (Idle/Movement/Core are ignored: walking, running, jumping...)
    ActionPriorities = {
        [Enum.AnimationPriority.Action]  = true,
        [Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2] = true,
        [Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3] = true,
        [Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4] = true,
    },
    -- Words to ignore in animation names (lowercase)
    IgnoreNames = { "idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "emote", "dance", "sit" },
    -- Keywords that force detection even if the priority is low
    ForceNames  = { "attack", "slash", "punch", "swing", "strike", "hit", "m1", "combo", "skill", "nen" },

    -- PARRY: only the animations that REALLY deal damage (measured from logs: they hit 0.38-0.43s after
    -- the animation starts). The boss' other animations (feints / stances) never hit: parrying them
    -- = a missed parry = 3s cooldown = you take everything.
    ParryOnlyIds     = true,
    -- true = standard delay (ReactionDelay); number = specific press delay (s after the animation starts)
    ParryIds = {
        ["100770856564580"] = true,
        ["130277557014228"] = true,
        ["91493878890049"]  = true,
        ["93314100789910"]  = true,
        ["93865528583760"]  = 0.03,   -- fast hit: lands 0.33s after the animation starts
    },
    PointBlank       = 4,             -- below this distance (studs) the attacker is always treated as a threat
    NormalHitAt      = 0.42,          -- impact time of a normal hit (used for the dodge fallback)

    -- DODGE (heavy attacks)
    DodgeKey         = Enum.KeyCode.Q, -- dodge / dash key in the game
    HeavyNames       = { "heavy", "smash", "slam", "charge", "critical", "crit", "ult", "finisher", "unblock", "grab", "m2" },
    HeavyMinLength   = 1.4,            -- an animation longer than this (s) is considered heavy
    DodgeLead        = 0.30,           -- the dodge starts X seconds BEFORE the impact (tunes the "perfect" dodge)
    HeavyHitFraction = 0.85,           -- estimated impact at x% of the real duration for an unknown heavy animation
    -- Known heavy attacks: animation id -> impact time (s after the start, speed included)
    --   at = fixed press delay (s): used for grab skills where you get locked and can no longer dash
    --   (add your own with Debug = true)
    HeavyDB = {
        -- Slow big hit (slowed animation). ~0.6s in, the boss grabs you (flinch animation, no dash
        -- possible), so we dash right away instead of waiting for the impact.
        ["120074647445778"] = { hit = 3.06, at = 0.05 },
        -- Skills that grab you and launch you in the air (LastRag): you are locked (flinch animation, dash
        -- impossible) 0.5-0.8s after the start -> dash IMMEDIATELY on the first animation.
        ["79940982521179"]  = { hit = 1.98, at = 0.05 },  -- followed by 121888999208574 0.53s later
        ["116767125715788"] = { hit = 1.12, at = 0.05 },  -- followed by 122047448848886 0.52s later
        ["92614875456334"]  = { hit = 1.54, at = 0.05 },
        ["90549446872856"]  = { hit = 2.44 },  -- same hit, 0.62s later (duplicate is ignored automatically)
        ["121888999208574"] = { hit = 1.45 },
        ["96968963810616"]  = { hit = 0.58 },
        ["108733713646184"] = { hit = 1.97 },
        ["101853308988006"] = { hit = 1.34 },  -- same hit as the previous one, 0.63s later
    },
    -- The game's dash needs a direction: if you are not moving, this key is held together with Q
    DodgeDirKey       = Enum.KeyCode.S,        -- S = backwards (you face the boss)
    DodgeDirHold      = 0.15,
    HeavyDedupeWindow = 0.9,           -- two heavy animations whose impacts are within X s = a single hit
    DodgeCooldown     = 0.6,           -- minimum delay between two dodges (s)
    -- Animations to ignore completely: the boss' parry / stagger (otherwise we "react" to its own parry)
    IgnoreIds = {
        ["14115657114"] = true,
        ["14115573519"] = true,
        ["17257966580"] = true,
    },

    -- Cancels your own attack (M1, combo...) right before parrying / dodging,
    -- so that an attack in progress does not block the defensive action
    CancelOwnAttack  = true,
    CancelFadeTime   = 0.05,           -- fade time (s) used to cut attack animations
    ClearAttributes  = { "Busy" },     -- character bool attributes reset to false ("busy" state)

    ParryEnabled     = true,           -- parry on normal attacks (toggle in the GUI)
    DodgeEnabled     = true,           -- dodge on heavy attacks (toggle in the GUI)

    -- AUTO FIGHT: walks up to the boss and only hits (M1) while it is in "endlag" (after its own
    -- attack or after your parry). Outside that window it parries your M1 and stuns you.
    AutoFight        = false,          -- toggle in the GUI or with FightKey
    FightKey         = Enum.KeyCode.G,
    BossNames        = { "Evil" },     -- model names treated as bosses (besides anything with NpcEndlagUntil)
    FightRange       = 200,            -- max distance to look for the boss
    ApproachDist     = 5.5,            -- stop walking at this distance
    AttackRange      = 8,              -- only attack below this distance
    AttackMinEndlag  = 0.30,           -- only attack if the boss still has at least X s of endlag
    ClickInterval    = 0.20,           -- delay between two M1 clicks

    -- RED ZONES: big attacks place a telegraph on the ground. You have to LEAVE it, not just dash.
    AvoidZones       = true,
    ZoneMinSize      = 8,              -- minimum largest dimension of a zone (studs)
    ZoneMaxThickness = 3,              -- zones are flat: max thickness (studs)
    ZoneMargin       = 2,              -- safety margin around the zone
    ZoneExitPad      = 4,              -- aim for a point X studs outside the zone
    ZoneDashDist     = 7,              -- if the exit point is farther than this, dash as well
    ZoneNames        = { "telegraph", "warning", "indicator", "danger", "aoe", "markeroverlay" },
    LogZones         = false,          -- writes every detected zone to apZones.txt (to tune the filters)

    ShowGui          = true,           -- show the small panel
    GuiToggleKey     = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl, -- hide / show the panel

    Debug = false,                     -- true: prints name/length/priority of every detected animation
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VIM              = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local enabled      = true
local lastParry    = 0
local lastDodge    = 0
local lastHeavyHit = -math.huge   -- impact time (os.clock) of the last scheduled heavy hit
local fleeUntil    = 0            -- while os.clock() < fleeUntil, auto fight does not move (we are leaving a zone)
local connections  = {}           -- global connections
local hooked       = {}           -- [Animator] = connection

local function track(conn)
    table.insert(connections, conn)
    return conn
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- UTILITIES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getRoot(model)
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function myRoot()
    return getRoot(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

local function notify(text)
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Auto Parry",
            Text = text,
            Duration = 2,
        })
    end)
end

local function nameMatches(name, list)
    name = string.lower(name or "")
    for _, word in ipairs(list) do
        if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Press a key (VirtualInputManager, with keypress fallback)
local function pressKey(keyCode)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
        task.wait(CONFIG.HoldTime)
        VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
    end)
    if not ok and keypress and keyrelease then
        local code = keyCode.Value
        pcall(keypress, code)
        task.wait(CONFIG.HoldTime)
        pcall(keyrelease, code)
    end
end

-- Cuts the local player's current attack to free up the defensive action
local function cancelOwnAttack()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    local animator = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
    if animator then
        for _, animTrack in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            if CONFIG.ActionPriorities[animTrack.Priority]
                and not nameMatches(animTrack.Name, CONFIG.IgnoreNames) then
                pcall(function() animTrack:Stop(CONFIG.CancelFadeTime) end)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, attr in ipairs(CONFIG.ClearAttributes) do
        if char:GetAttribute(attr) == true then
            pcall(function() char:SetAttribute(attr, false) end)
        end
    end
end

local function defend(keyCode, dirKey)
    if CONFIG.CancelOwnAttack then
        cancelOwnAttack()
        task.wait()  -- let the game register the cancellation before the key press
    end

    -- Dash: without a held direction the game ignores Q, so we hold a movement key
    local dir = dirKey or CONFIG.DodgeDirKey
    if keyCode == CONFIG.DodgeKey and dir then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if dirKey or (hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1) then
            pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, dir, false, game) end)
            task.wait(0.04)
            pressKey(keyCode)
            task.wait(CONFIG.DodgeDirHold)
            pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, dir, false, game) end)
            return
        end
    end

    pressKey(keyCode)
end

local function doParry()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastParry < CONFIG.Cooldown then
        return
    end
    lastParry = now
    task.spawn(defend, CONFIG.ParryKey)
end

local function doDodge(dirKey)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastDodge < CONFIG.DodgeCooldown then
        return
    end
    lastDodge = now
    task.spawn(defend, CONFIG.DodgeKey, dirKey)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DETECTION
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Is the attacker close enough and facing us?
local function isThreat(attackerModel)
    local mine, theirs = myRoot(), getRoot(attackerModel)
    if not mine or not theirs then
        return false
    end

    local offset = mine.Position - theirs.Position
    local dist = offset.Magnitude
    if dist > CONFIG.Range then
        return false
    end
    if dist < 0.1 then
        return true
    end

    -- in melee range the boss overlaps you: the facing test becomes noise
    if dist <= CONFIG.PointBlank then
        return true
    end

    local facing = theirs.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit)
    return facing >= CONFIG.FacingDot
end

local function animName(animTrack)
    local anim = animTrack.Animation
    return (anim and anim.Name) or animTrack.Name or ""
end

local function animId(animTrack)
    local anim = animTrack.Animation
    return anim and string.match(anim.AnimationId, "%d+") or ""
end

local function isAttackAnimation(animTrack)
    local name = animName(animTrack)

    if nameMatches(name, CONFIG.ForceNames) then
        return true
    end
    if nameMatches(name, CONFIG.IgnoreNames) then
        return false
    end
    return CONFIG.ActionPriorities[animTrack.Priority] == true
end

-- Heavy attack: known id, explicit name or long animation
local function isHeavyAnimation(animTrack)
    if CONFIG.HeavyDB[animId(animTrack)] then
        return true
    end
    if nameMatches(animName(animTrack), CONFIG.HeavyNames) then
        return true
    end
    -- length alone is not enough: otherwise long idles / emotes would count as "heavy"
    return animTrack.Length >= CONFIG.HeavyMinLength and isAttackAnimation(animTrack)
end

local function onAnimationPlayed(attackerModel, animTrack)
    if not enabled then return end
    if CONFIG.IgnoreIds[animId(animTrack)] then return end

    local heavy = CONFIG.DodgeEnabled and isHeavyAnimation(animTrack)
    if not heavy and not (CONFIG.ParryEnabled and isAttackAnimation(animTrack)) then return end
    if not isThreat(attackerModel) then return end

    if CONFIG.Debug then
        print(string.format("[AutoParry] %s | %s id=%s | len=%.2f | prio=%s | %s",
            attackerModel.Name, animName(animTrack), animId(animTrack), animTrack.Length,
            animTrack.Priority.Name, heavy and "DODGE" or "PARRY"))
    end

    if heavy then
        -- Perfect dodge: aim for the impact time (known or estimated) minus DodgeLead.
        -- No IsPlaying check here: the boss cuts/replaces its animations while the hit still lands.
        local entry = CONFIG.HeavyDB[animId(animTrack)]
        local speed = math.max(animTrack.Speed, 0.1)
        local hitAt = entry and entry.hit or (animTrack.Length / speed) * CONFIG.HeavyHitFraction
        local delay = entry and entry.at or math.max(0, hitAt - CONFIG.DodgeLead)

        -- the same heavy hit often arrives through 2 animations: only one dash (cooldown ~2.3s)
        local now = os.clock()
        local absHit = now + hitAt
        if math.abs(absHit - lastHeavyHit) < CONFIG.HeavyDedupeWindow and lastHeavyHit > now - 0.2 then
            return
        end
        lastHeavyHit = absHit

        task.delay(delay, function()
            if enabled and CONFIG.DodgeEnabled and isThreat(attackerModel) then
                doDodge()
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    -- animation that never deals damage: don't waste the parry
    if CONFIG.ParryOnlyIds and not CONFIG.ParryIds[animId(animTrack)] then return end

    local pressDelay = CONFIG.ParryIds[animId(animTrack)]
    if type(pressDelay) ~= "number" then pressDelay = CONFIG.ReactionDelay end

    task.delay(pressDelay, function()
        -- re-check: the animation is still playing and the threat is still there
        if not (enabled and animTrack.IsPlaying and isThreat(attackerModel)) then return end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:GetAttribute("ParryOnCooldown") == true then
            -- parry unavailable: F would only block. Dodge instead if the dash is free.
            if CONFIG.DodgeEnabled and char:GetAttribute("DashCooldown") ~= true then
                local wait = math.max(0, CONFIG.NormalHitAt - CONFIG.DodgeLead - CONFIG.ReactionDelay)
                task.delay(wait, function()
                    if enabled and isThreat(attackerModel) then doDodge() end
                end)
            end
            return
        end

        doParry()
    end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HOOKING THE ANIMATORS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function shouldWatch(model)
    if model == LocalPlayer.Character then
        return false
    end
    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
    if isPlayer then
        return CONFIG.TargetPlayers
    end
    return CONFIG.TargetNPCs
end

local function hookAnimator(animator)
    if hooked[animator] then return end

    local model = animator:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if not model or not shouldWatch(model) then return end

    hooked[animator] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animTrack)
        onAnimationPlayed(model, animTrack)
    end)

    animator.Destroying:Connect(function()
        if hooked[animator] then
            hooked[animator]:Disconnect()
            hooked[animator] = nil
        end
    end)
end

for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if inst:IsA("Animator") then
        hookAnimator(inst)
    end
end

track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
    if inst:IsA("Animator") then
        -- small delay: the model is not always parented yet at this point
        task.defer(hookAnimator, inst)
    end
end))

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO FIGHT
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local bossModel
local lastScan, lastClick = 0, 0

local function isBoss(model)
    if model == LocalPlayer.Character or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
        return false
    end
    if model:GetAttribute("NpcEndlagUntil") ~= nil then
        return true
    end
    return table.find(CONFIG.BossNames, model.Name) ~= nil
end

local function bossAlive(model)
    if not model or not model.Parent then return false end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and getRoot(model) ~= nil
end

local function findBoss()
    local root = myRoot()
    if not root then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, CONFIG.FightRange
    for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
            local model = inst.Parent
            if model and model:IsA("Model") and isBoss(model) and bossAlive(model) then
                local d = (getRoot(model).Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = model, d end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- time left (s) before the boss' endlag ends; <= 0 = it can parry your M1
local function endlagLeft(model)
    local untilAt = model:GetAttribute("NpcEndlagUntil")
    if type(untilAt) ~= "number" then return 0 end
    return untilAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function clickM1()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local c = cam and (cam.ViewportSize / 2) or Vector2.new(400, 300)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(c.X, c.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
        task.wait(0.03)
        VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(c.X, c.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
    end)
    if not ok and mouse1click then
        pcall(mouse1click)   -- fallback for executors without VirtualInputManager
    end
end

local fightAccum = 0
track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    fightAccum += dt
    if fightAccum < 0.05 then return end
    fightAccum = 0
    if not (enabled and CONFIG.AutoFight) then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = myRoot()
    if not (hum and root and hum.Health > 0) then return end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now < fleeUntil then return end   -- we are leaving a red zone
    if not bossAlive(bossModel) and now - lastScan > 1 then
        lastScan = now
        bossModel = findBoss()
    end
    if not bossAlive(bossModel) then return end

    -- don't touch anything while dashing (it would break the dodge)
    if char:GetAttribute("LocalDashing") ~= nil or char:GetAttribute("ActiveDashId") ~= nil then return end

    local bpos = getRoot(bossModel).Position
    local flat = Vector3.new(bpos.X - root.Position.X, 0, bpos.Z - root.Position.Z)
    local dist = flat.Magnitude

    -- face the boss
    if dist > 0.5 and dist < 40 then
        root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat)
    end

    -- approach
    if dist > CONFIG.ApproachDist then
        hum:MoveTo(bpos)
    end

    -- only attack during the boss' endlag
    if dist <= CONFIG.AttackRange
        and endlagLeft(bossModel) >= CONFIG.AttackMinEndlag
        and now - lastClick >= CONFIG.ClickInterval then
        lastClick = now
        task.spawn(clickM1)
    end
end))

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RED ZONES (telegraphs of big attacks)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local zones = {}   -- [BasePart] = time it appeared

local function zoneLog(line)
    if CONFIG.LogZones and appendfile then
        pcall(appendfile, "apZones.txt", string.format("%.2f|%s\n", os.clock(), line))
    end
end

local function belongsToCharacter(inst)
    local m = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    while m do
        if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
        m = m.Parent and m.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    return false
end

local function isRedish(c)
    return c.R >= 0.6 and c.G <= 0.4 and c.B <= 0.4
end

local function zoneCandidate(part)
    if belongsToCharacter(part) then return false end
    -- the boss' real zones are called BossTelegraph*: accepted whatever their size
    -- (the "Fill" grows over time, it is small when it appears)
    if nameMatches(part.Name, CONFIG.ZoneNames) or nameMatches(part.Parent and part.Parent.Name or "", CONFIG.ZoneNames) then
        return true
    end
    local s = part.Size
    local mx, mn = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z), math.min(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
    if mx < CONFIG.ZoneMinSize or mn > CONFIG.ZoneMaxThickness then return false end
    return part.Transparency < 0.98 and isRedish(part.Color)
end

-- Telemetry: follows a "telegraph" zone for ~2s (size, position in the boss' frame of reference)
local function watchTelegraph(part)
    task.spawn(function()
        local boss = bossModel
        if not (boss and boss.Parent) then
            for _, m in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if m:IsA("Model") and table.find(CONFIG.BossNames, m.Name) and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then boss = m break end
            end
        end
        local broot = boss and getRoot(boss)
        for i = 1, 20 do
            if not part.Parent then zoneLog(part.Name .. " destroyed at +" .. string.format("%.2f", (i - 1) * 0.1)) return end
            local mine = myRoot()
            local rel = broot and broot.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(part.Position) or Vector3.zero
            local me = (broot and mine) and broot.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(mine.Position) or Vector3.zero
            zoneLog(string.format("  %s +%.1fs size=%s transp=%.2f center(boss space)=%s me(boss space)=%s",
                part.Name, (i - 1) * 0.1, tostring(part.Size), part.Transparency, tostring(rel), tostring(me)))
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end

-- axes: (thickness, u, v) in the part's local coordinates
local function zoneAxes(part)
    local s = part.Size
    if s.X <= s.Y and s.X <= s.Z then return "X", "Y", "Z" end
    if s.Y <= s.Z then return "Y", "X", "Z" end
    return "Z", "X", "Y"
end

-- returns (inside, world exit point)
local function zoneTest(part, pos)
    local cf, s = part.CFrame, part.Size
    local lp = cf:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
    local t, u, v = zoneAxes(part)
    if math.abs(lp[t]) > s[t] / 2 + 12 then return false end

    local hu, hv = s[u] / 2 + CONFIG.ZoneMargin, s[v] / 2 + CONFIG.ZoneMargin
    local pu, pv = lp[u], lp[v]
    local round = part:IsA("Part") and (part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball or part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder)

    local inside, tu, tv
    if round then
        local k = (pu / hu) ^ 2 + (pv / hv) ^ 2
        inside = k <= 1
        if k < 0.01 then
            -- right at the center: arbitrary exit direction (u axis)
            tu, tv = hu + CONFIG.ZoneExitPad, 0
        else
            local len = math.sqrt(k)
            tu, tv = pu / len * (1 + CONFIG.ZoneExitPad / hu), pv / len * (1 + CONFIG.ZoneExitPad / hv)
        end
    else
        inside = math.abs(pu) <= hu and math.abs(pv) <= hv
        if math.abs(hu - math.abs(pu)) <= math.abs(hv - math.abs(pv)) then
            tu = (pu >= 0 and 1 or -1) * (hu + CONFIG.ZoneExitPad); tv = pv
        else
            tv = (pv >= 0 and 1 or -1) * (hv + CONFIG.ZoneExitPad); tu = pu
        end
    end
    if not inside then return false end

    local target = { X = 0, Y = 0, Z = 0 }
    target[t], target[u], target[v] = lp[t], tu, tv
    return true, cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(target.X, target.Y, target.Z))
end

local function registerZone(part)
    if zones[part] or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if not zoneCandidate(part) then return end
    zones[part] = os.clock()
    local mine = myRoot()
    zoneLog(string.format("ZONE %s | %s | size=%s | color=%s | transp=%.2f | shape=%s | dist=%.1f",
        part:GetFullName(), part.ClassName, tostring(part.Size), tostring(part.Color), part.Transparency,
        part:IsA("Part") and part.Shape.Name or "-", mine and (mine.Position - part.Position).Magnitude or -1))
    part.Destroying:Connect(function() zones[part] = nil end)
    if CONFIG.LogZones and nameMatches(part.Name, CONFIG.ZoneNames) then
        watchTelegraph(part)
    end
end

track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        -- give the properties (size / color) time to be set
        task.delay(0.05, function() if inst.Parent then registerZone(inst) end end)
    elseif CONFIG.LogZones and nameMatches(inst.Name, CONFIG.ZoneNames) then
        zoneLog("OTHER " .. inst.ClassName .. " " .. inst:GetFullName())
    end
end))

local zoneAccum = 0
track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    zoneAccum += dt
    if zoneAccum < 0.05 then return end
    zoneAccum = 0
    if not (enabled and CONFIG.AvoidZones) then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = myRoot()
    if not (hum and root and hum.Health > 0) then return end

    local bestExit
    for part in pairs(zones) do
        if not part.Parent then
            zones[part] = nil
        else
            local inside, exitPos = zoneTest(part, root.Position)
            if inside then bestExit = exitPos break end
        end
    end
    if not bestExit then return end

    fleeUntil = os.clock() + 0.4
    local toExit = Vector3.new(bestExit.X - root.Position.X, 0, bestExit.Z - root.Position.Z)
    hum:MoveTo(bestExit)

    -- too far to walk out in time: dash toward the exit
    if toExit.Magnitude > CONFIG.ZoneDashDist and char:GetAttribute("DashCooldown") ~= true
        and char:GetAttribute("LocalDashing") == nil then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local look = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
        local right = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit
        local dirn = toExit.Unit
        local f, r = dirn:Dot(look), dirn:Dot(right)
        local key
        if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then key = f >= 0 and Enum.KeyCode.W or Enum.KeyCode.S
        else key = r >= 0 and Enum.KeyCode.D or Enum.KeyCode.A end
        doDodge(key)
    end
end))

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI (small draggable panel with toggle switches)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local screenGui
local refreshGui = function() end

local function buildGui()
    local parent
    if gethui then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        parent = ok and h or nil
    end
    if not parent then
        local ok, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        parent = ok and cg or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end

    screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name = "BeyondNenAutoParry"
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    screenGui.DisplayOrder = 999
    screenGui.Parent = parent

    local ON, OFF = Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 90), Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 78)

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(176, 0)
    frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.4, 0)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", frame)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
    pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6), UDim.new(0, 6)

    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", frame)
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    -- title bar (also the drag handle)
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.LayoutOrder = 0
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextSize = 13
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
    title.Text = "Auto Parry"
    title.Parent = frame

    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    track(title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end))
    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                       startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end))
    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))

    -- switches: { label, getter, setter }
    local rows = {
        { "Auto Parry",    function() return enabled end,                function(v) enabled = v end },
        { "Parry",         function() return CONFIG.ParryEnabled end,    function(v) CONFIG.ParryEnabled = v end },
        { "Heavy dodge",   function() return CONFIG.DodgeEnabled end,    function(v) CONFIG.DodgeEnabled = v end },
        { "Cancel my atk", function() return CONFIG.CancelOwnAttack end, function(v) CONFIG.CancelOwnAttack = v end },
        { "Avoid zones",   function() return CONFIG.AvoidZones end,      function(v) CONFIG.AvoidZones = v end },
        { "Auto Fight",    function() return CONFIG.AutoFight end,       function(v) CONFIG.AutoFight = v end },
    }

    local buttons = {}
    for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.LayoutOrder = i
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
        btn.AutoButtonColor = true
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.TextSize = 12
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        btn.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

        track(btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            row[3](not row[2]())
            refreshGui()
        end))
        buttons[i] = btn
    end

    refreshGui = function()
        for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
            local on = row[2]()
            buttons[i].Text = row[1] .. "   " .. (on and "ON" or "OFF")
            buttons[i].BackgroundColor3 = on and ON or OFF
        end
        -- sub-options are dimmed while the auto parry is off
        for i = 2, #rows do
            buttons[i].TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or 0.5
        end
    end
    refreshGui()
end

if CONFIG.ShowGui then
    local ok, err = pcall(buildGui)
    if not ok then
        warn("[AutoParry] GUI unavailable: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- KEYS + UNLOAD
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function unload()
    enabled = false
    if screenGui then
        pcall(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
        screenGui = nil
    end
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    for animator, conn in pairs(hooked) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        hooked[animator] = nil
    end
    env.BeyondNenAutoParry = nil
    notify("Unloaded")
end

env.BeyondNenAutoParry = unload

track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == CONFIG.ToggleKey then
        enabled = not enabled
        refreshGui()
        notify(enabled and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.FightKey then
        CONFIG.AutoFight = not CONFIG.AutoFight
        refreshGui()
        notify("Auto Fight " .. (CONFIG.AutoFight and "ON" or "OFF"))
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.GuiToggleKey then
        if screenGui then
            screenGui.Enabled = not screenGui.Enabled
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.UnloadKey then
        unload()
    end
end))

notify("Loaded - [" .. CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name .. "] on/off, [" .. CONFIG.UnloadKey.Name .. "] unload")

scripts.summary: HD Admin: Fly Noclip Size Headsize Invisible Neon God Infinitjump Thanks for use me script.
scripts.code:
--========================================================
-- HD ADMIN v2.2.0
-- by Voltex Studios
-- Interface inspired by the supplied reference image
-- Client-side utilities for your own character only.
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Remove an older copy
pcall(function()
    local old = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local found = old:FindFirstChild("HD_ADMIN")
    if found then found:Destroy() end
end)

local GUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
GUI.Name = "HD_ADMIN"
GUI.ResetOnSpawn = false
GUI.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

local parentOK = pcall(function()
    GUI.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
if not parentOK or not GUI.Parent then
    GUI.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local Settings = {
    Theme = "Dark",
    BackgroundTransparency = 0,
    Rounded = true,
    Scale = 1,
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245),
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,11),
    Panel = Color3.fromRGB(24,24,26),
    Tile = Color3.fromRGB(37,37,40),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(248,248,248),
    Muted = Color3.fromRGB(155,155,160)
}

local function create(class, parent, props)
    local obj = Instance.new(class)
    for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do
        obj[k] = v
    end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end

local function corner(obj, radius)
    return create("UICorner", obj, {
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Settings.Rounded and radius or 2)
    })
end

local function outline(obj, color)
    return create("UIStroke", obj, {
        Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(58,58,62),
        Thickness = 1,
        Transparency = 0.12
    })
end

local function tween(obj, props, duration)
    TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function label(parent, text, size, pos, color, bold)
    return create("TextLabel", parent, {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text,
        TextColor3 = color or Settings.Text,
        TextSize = size,
        Position = pos,
        Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    })
end

local logs = {}
local notification
local function log(message)
    table.insert(logs, 1, os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "  •  " .. tostring(message))
    while #logs > 50 do table.remove(logs) end
end

local function notify(message)
    log(message)
    if notification then notification:Destroy() end
    notification = create("Frame", GUI, {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(245, 52),
        Position = UDim2.new(1,-260,1,-68),
        BackgroundColor3 = Settings.Panel,
        BackgroundTransparency = Settings.BackgroundTransparency,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 20
    })
    corner(notification, 9)
    outline(notification)
    label(notification, "HD ADMIN", 11, UDim2.fromOffset(12,5), Settings.Muted, true).Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,16)
    local msg = label(notification, tostring(message), 12, UDim2.fromOffset(12,23), Settings.Text, false)
    msg.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,22)
    msg.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    task.delay(2.8, function()
        if notification then notification:Destroy(); notification = nil end
    end)
end

-- Character helpers
local function character() return LP.Character end
local function humanoid()
    local c = character()
    return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function root()
    local c = character()
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function head()
    local c = character()
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

local original = {}
local function saveCharacter()
    table.clear(original)
    local c = character()
    if not c then return end
    for _,obj in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            original[obj] = {
                Size = obj.Size,
                Material = obj.Material,
                Color = obj.Color,
                Transparency = obj.Transparency,
                LocalTransparencyModifier = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier,
                CanCollide = obj.CanCollide
            }
        end
    end
end
if character() then saveCharacter() end
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    saveCharacter()
end)

local states = {Fly=false, NoClip=false, InfiniteJump=false}
local connections = {}
local flyObjects = {}

local function stopConnection(name)
    if connections[name] then
        connections[name]:Disconnect()
        connections[name] = nil
    end
end

local function fly(speed)
    states.Fly = not states.Fly
    stopConnection("Fly")
    for _,obj in ipairs(flyObjects) do pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
    table.clear(flyObjects)
    if not states.Fly then notify("Fly desativado"); return end

    local r = root()
    if not r then states.Fly=false; notify("Personagem não encontrado"); return end

    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6)
    velocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    velocity.Parent = r
    local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6)
    gyro.P = 10000
    gyro.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
    gyro.Parent = r
    flyObjects = {velocity,gyro}

    connections.Fly = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not states.Fly or not r.Parent then return end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local direction = Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then direction += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then direction -= Vector3.yAxis end
        velocity.Velocity = direction * (speed or 60)
        gyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)
    notify("Fly ativado — WASD / Espaço / Ctrl")
end

local function noclip()
    states.NoClip = not states.NoClip
    stopConnection("NoClip")
    if states.NoClip then
        connections.NoClip = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            local c = character()
            if c then
                for _,obj in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
        end)
        notify("NoClip ativado")
    else
        for obj,data in pairs(original) do
            if obj.Parent then obj.CanCollide = data.CanCollide end
        end
        notify("NoClip desativado")
    end
end

local function infiniteJump()
    states.InfiniteJump = not states.InfiniteJump
    stopConnection("InfiniteJump")
    if states.InfiniteJump then
        connections.InfiniteJump = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
            local h = humanoid()
            if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
        end)
        notify("Infinite Jump ativado")
    else
        notify("Infinite Jump desativado")
    end
end

local function applyMaterial(material)
    local c = character()
    if not c then return end
    for _,obj in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.Material = material end
    end
    notify(material.Name .. " aplicado")
end

local function headSize(value)
    local h = head()
    if not h then return end
    local data = original[h]
    h.Size = (data and data.Size or h.Size) * math.clamp(value,0.5,5)
    notify("HeadSize: " .. tostring(value))
end

local function bodySize(value)
    local h = humanoid()
    if not h then return end
    value = math.clamp(value,0.5,3)
    for _,name in ipairs({"BodyWidthScale","BodyHeightScale","BodyDepthScale","HeadScale"}) do
        local scale = h:FindFirstChild(name)
        if scale and scale:IsA("NumberValue") then scale.Value = value end
    end
    notify("Size: " .. tostring(value))
end

local function setTitle(text)
    local h = head()
    if not h then return end
    local old = h:FindFirstChild("HDAdminTitle")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local billboard = create("BillboardGui", h, {
        Name = "HDAdminTitle",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220,45),
        StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.7,0),
        AlwaysOnTop = true
    })
    create("TextLabel", billboard, {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = tostring(text),
        TextColor3 = Settings.Accent,
        TextStrokeTransparency = 0,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 18
    })
    notify("Título local aplicado")
end

local function setSpeed(value)
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then h.WalkSpeed = math.clamp(value,0,200); notify("Speed: "..value) end
end
local function setJump(value)
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then h.UseJumpPower=true; h.JumpPower=math.clamp(value,0,200); notify("Jump: "..value) end
end
local function heal()
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then h.Health=h.MaxHealth; notify("Vida restaurada") end
end
local function god()
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then h.MaxHealth=100000; h.Health=h.MaxHealth; notify("Vida local alterada") end
end
local function invisible()
    local c = character()
    if not c then return end
    for _,obj in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end
    end
    notify("Invisibilidade local ativada")
end

local function restore()
    states.Fly=false; states.NoClip=false; states.InfiniteJump=false
    for name in pairs(connections) do stopConnection(name) end
    for _,obj in ipairs(flyObjects) do pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
    table.clear(flyObjects)
    local h = humanoid()
    if h then
        h.WalkSpeed=16
        h.UseJumpPower=true
        h.JumpPower=50
        h.MaxHealth=100
        h.Health=100
    end
    for obj,data in pairs(original) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            obj.Size=data.Size
            obj.Material=data.Material
            obj.Color=data.Color
            obj.Transparency=data.Transparency
            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=data.LocalTransparencyModifier
            obj.CanCollide=data.CanCollide
        end
    end
    local hd=head()
    if hd then
        local titleObj=hd:FindFirstChild("HDAdminTitle")
        if titleObj then titleObj:Destroy() end
    end
    notify("Configurações originais restauradas")
end

local commands = {
    fly=function() fly(60) end,
    fly2=function() fly(100) end,
    noclip=noclip,
    infinitejump=infiniteJump,
    neon=function() applyMaterial(Enum.Material.Neon) end,
    glass=function() applyMaterial(Enum.Material.Glass) end,
    heal=heal,
    god=god,
    invisible=invisible,
    restore=restore,
    reset=function() if character() then character():BreakJoints() end end,
    speed=function(a) setSpeed(tonumber(a[3]) or 50) end,
    jump=function(a) setJump(tonumber(a[3]) or 100) end,
    headsize=function(a) headSize(tonumber(a[3]) or 2) end,
    size=function(a) bodySize(tonumber(a[3]) or 2) end,
    title=function(a) setTitle(table.concat(a," ",3) ~= "" and table.concat(a," ",3) or "ADMIN") end
}

local function executeChat(message)
    if message:sub(1,1) ~= ";" then return end
    local args = string.split(message," ")
    local command = (args[1] or ""):sub(2):lower()
    local target = (args[2] or "me"):lower()
    if target ~= "me" and target ~= LP.Name:lower() then
        notify("Por segurança, esta versão só altera seu personagem")
        return
    end
    local fn = commands[command]
    if fn then
        local ok,err = pcall(function() fn(args) end)
        if not ok then notify("Erro: "..tostring(err)) end
    else
        notify("Comando desconhecido: "..command)
    end

scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')

    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }

end

local function CaptureMainTransparency()
    if MainTransparencyValues then
        return
    end

    MainTransparencyValues = {}

    local function SaveProperty(Object, Property)
        local Success, Value = pcall(function()
            return Object[Property]
        end)

        if Success then
            MainTransparencyValues[#MainTransparencyValues + 1] = {
                Object = Object,
                Property = Property,
                Value = Value
            }
        end
    end

    local function CaptureObject(Object)
        if Object:IsA("GuiObject") then
            SaveProperty(Object, "BackgroundTransparency")
        end

        if Object:IsA("TextLabel")
        or Object:IsA("TextButton")
        or Object:IsA("TextBox") then
            SaveProperty(Object, "TextTransparency")
            SaveProperty(Object, "TextStrokeTransparency")
        end

        if Object:IsA("ImageLabel")
        or Object:IsA("ImageButton") then
            SaveProperty(Object, "ImageTransparency")
        end

        if Object:IsA("UIStroke") then
            SaveProperty(Object, "Transparency")
        end
    end

    CaptureObject(Main)

    for _, Object in ipairs(Main:GetDescendants()) do
        CaptureObject(Object)
    end
end

local function TweenMainTransparency(FadeOut)
    CaptureMainTransparency()

    for _, Entry in ipairs(MainTransparencyValues) do
        local Object = Entry.Object

        if Object and Object.Parent then
            local Target = FadeOut and 1 or Entry.Value

            local Success, Tween = pcall(function()
                return TweenService:Create(
                    Object,
                    AnimationInfo,
                    {
                        [Entry.Property] = Target
                    }
                )
            end)

            if Success and Tween then
                Tween:Play()
            end
        end
    end
end

local GradeColors = {
    bronze = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50),
    silver = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240),
    gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0),
    diamond = Color3.fromRGB(85, 190, 255),

    common = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
    uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 100),
    rare = Color3.fromRGB(65, 150, 255),
    epic = Color3.fromRGB(180, 85, 255),
    legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0),
    mythic = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 100),
    divine = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 210),
    secret = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    platinum = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)
}

local function GetGradeColor(G)
    if G == nil then
        return Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    end

    local Name = tostring(G):lower()
    return GradeColors[Name] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

--==================================================
-- ANIMAL TAG CHECK
--==================================================

local function GetTagPrompt(M)
    local TagSpot = M:FindFirstChild("TagSpot", true)

    if not TagSpot then
        return nil
    end

    return TagSpot:FindFirstChild("TagPrompt", true)
end

local function GetAnimalOwnerId(M)
    local Prompt = GetTagPrompt(M)

    if not Prompt then
        return nil, nil
    end

    return Prompt:GetAttribute("OwnerId"), Prompt
end

local function IsTaggedByOtherPlayer(M)
    local OwnerId = GetAnimalOwnerId(M)

    if OwnerId == nil then
        return false
    end

    return tonumber(OwnerId) ~= Player.UserId
end

local function ConnectAnimalOwner(M, Entry)
    local _, Prompt = GetAnimalOwnerId(M)

    if not Prompt then
        return
    end

    if Entry.OwnerPrompt == Prompt
    and Entry.OwnerConnection then
        return
    end

    if Entry.OwnerConnection then
        Entry.OwnerConnection:Disconnect()
        Entry.OwnerConnection = nil
    end

    Entry.OwnerPrompt = Prompt

    Entry.OwnerConnection =
        Prompt:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OwnerId"):Connect(function()
            if not Enabled or Closed then
                return
            end

            if IsTaggedByOtherPlayer(M) then
                Remove(M)
            else
                QueueAnimalRepair(M)
            end
        end)
end

    if not Enabled or Closed then
        return
    end

    if not M or not M:IsA("Model") or not M.Parent then
        return
    end

    if IsTaggedByOtherPlayer(M) then
        Remove(M)
        return
    end

    local Entry = Objects[M]

    if not Entry then
        Entry = {
            Highlight = nil,
            Billboard = nil,
            Label = nil,

            OwnerConnection = nil,
            OwnerPrompt = nil,

            HighlightConnection = nil,
            BillboardConnection = nil,
            LabelConnection = nil
        }

        Objects[M] = Entry
    end

    ConnectAnimalOwner(M, Entry)

    CreateAnimalHighlight(M, Entry)
    CreateAnimalLabel(M, Entry)
end

local function StartAnimalRepairWorker()
    if AnimalRepairWorkerRunning then
        return
    end

    AnimalRepairWorkerRunning = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while Enabled and not Closed do
            for M in pairs(AnimalRepairQueue) do
                AnimalRepairQueue[M] = nil

                local Entry = Objects[M]

                if Entry and M.Parent then
                    if IsTaggedByOtherPlayer(M) then
                        Remove(M)
                    else
                        ConnectAnimalOwner(M, Entry)

                        CreateAnimalHighlight(M, Entry)
                        CreateAnimalLabel(M, Entry)
                    end
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.3)
        end

        AnimalRepairWorkerRunning = false
    end)
end

local AutoTPRunning = false

local function AutoTeleportToDeadAnimal()
    if Closed or AutoTPRunning then
        return
    end

    AutoTPRunning = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while not Closed do
            local Character = Player.Character

            if not Character then
                break
            end

            local HRP = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if not HRP then
                break
            end

            local FoundAnimal = false

            for _, M in ipairs(Animals:GetDescendants()) do
                if M:IsA("Model") then
                    local OwnerId, Prompt = GetAnimalOwnerId(M)

                    if Prompt and OwnerId ~= nil then
                        if tonumber(OwnerId) == Player.UserId then

                            local TagSpot = M:FindFirstChild("TagSpot", true)

                            if TagSpot and TagSpot:IsA("Attachment") then
                                FoundAnimal = true

                                local TargetPosition = TagSpot.WorldPosition

                                local ParentPart = TagSpot.Parent
                                local HeightOffset = 0

                                if ParentPart and ParentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    HeightOffset = ParentPart.Size.Y * 0.60
                                end

                                local CurrentPivot = Character:GetPivot()
                                local Rotation = CurrentPivot - CurrentPivot.Position

                                Character:PivotTo(
                                    CFrame.new(
                                        TargetPosition + Vector3.new(0, HeightOffset, 0)
                                    ) * Rotation
                                )

                                local BodyPart = M:FindFirstChild("Body", true)

                                if BodyPart and BodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    task.wait()

                                    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

                                    if Camera then
                                        Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                                            Camera.CFrame.Position,
                                            BodyPart.Position
                                        )

                                        Camera.Focus = CFrame.new(BodyPart.Position)
                                    end
                                end

                                -- SPAM TAG PROMPT UNTIL ANIMAL DISAPPEARS
                                if Prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                                    Prompt.HoldDuration = 0.01

                                    while not Closed
                                        and M:IsDescendantOf(Animals)
                                        and Prompt.Parent do

                                        Prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                                        task.wait(0.01)
                                        Prompt:InputHoldEnd()
                                        task.wait(0.01)
                                    end
                                else
                                    while not Closed and M:IsDescendantOf(Animals) do
                                        task.wait(0.05)
                                    end
                                end

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if not FoundAnimal then
                break
            end
        end

        AutoTPRunning = false
    end)
end

AutoTPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(AutoTeleportToDeadAnimal)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER REPAIR WORKER
--==================================================

local function StartPlayerRepairWorker()
    if RepairWorkerRunning then
        return
    end

    RepairWorkerRunning = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while PlayersEnabled and not Closed do

            -- Repair queued characters first
            for Character in pairs(PlayerRepairQueue) do
                PlayerRepairQueue[Character] = nil

                local Entry = PlayerESPTable[Character]

                if Entry and Character.Parent then
                    CreatePlayerHighlight(Character, Entry)
                    CreatePlayerLabel(Entry.Player, Character, Entry)
                end
            end

            -- Check ALL tracked characters every 0.3 seconds
            for Character, Entry in pairs(PlayerESPTable) do
                if Character.Parent then

                    -- Recreate missing highlight
                    if not Entry.Highlight or not Entry.Highlight.Parent then
                        CreatePlayerHighlight(Character, Entry)
                    end

                    -- Recreate missing label
                    if not Entry.Billboard
                    or not Entry.Billboard.Parent
                    or not Entry.Label
                    or not Entry.Label.Parent then

                        CreatePlayerLabel(Entry.Player, Character, Entry)
                    end

                else
                    RemovePlayerCharacter(Character)
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.3)
        end

        RepairWorkerRunning = false
    end)
end

--==================================================
-- TRACK PLAYERS
--==================================================

local function RemovePlayer(TargetPlayer)
    for Character, Entry in pairs(PlayerESPTable) do
        if Entry.Player == TargetPlayer then
            RemovePlayerCharacter(Character)
        end
    end
end

local function TrackPlayer(TargetPlayer)
    if not TargetPlayer or TargetPlayer == Player then
        return
    end

    if PlayerConnections[TargetPlayer] then
        return
    end

    local C = {}
    PlayerConnections[TargetPlayer] = C

    C[#C + 1] = TargetPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character)
        if PlayersEnabled and not Closed then
            AddPlayerCharacter(TargetPlayer, Character)
        end
    end)

    C[#C + 1] = TargetPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(Character)
        RemovePlayerCharacter(Character)
    end)

    if PlayersEnabled and TargetPlayer.Character then
        AddPlayerCharacter(TargetPlayer, TargetPlayer.Character)
    end
end

local function StopTrackingPlayer(TargetPlayer)
    RemovePlayer(TargetPlayer)

    local C = PlayerConnections[TargetPlayer]

    if C then
        for _, Connection in ipairs(C) do
            Connection:Disconnect()
        end

        PlayerConnections[TargetPlayer] = nil
    end
end

local function ClearPlayers()
    for Character in pairs(PlayerESPTable) do
        RemovePlayerCharacter(Character)
    end

    table.clear(PlayerRepairQueue)
end

    if DistanceAccumulator < 0.2 then

    local LocalCharacter = Player.Character
    local LocalRoot = LocalCharacter
        and LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    for Character, Entry in pairs(PlayerESPTable) do

            RemovePlayerCharacter(Character)

        elseif Entry.Label and Entry.Label.Parent then
            local TargetRoot = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if LocalRoot and TargetRoot then
                local Distance =
                    (LocalRoot.Position - TargetRoot.Position).Magnitude

                Entry.Label.Text = Entry.Player.Name
                    .. " | "
                    .. tostring(math.floor(Distance + 0.5))
                    .. " studs"
            else
                Entry.Label.Text = Entry.Player.Name .. " | -- studs"
            end
        end
    end
end)
